chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The most appropriate person for an honourable position is he who descends from the people of honour.

key_terms.الْكَرَمِ: Honor, nobility, or an honorable position
key_terms.الْكِرَامُ: The noble ones, people of honor

ai.seo_question: Who is most deserving of honor according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) asserts that the most deserving of honor is one whose lineage is marked by the 'sweat of nobility' (irkat al-kiram), a metaphor for the accumulated virtue and exertion of ancestors. In Shia scholarly tradition, this highlights that true nobility is not merely genetic but is validated through the moral and spiritual exertion of the forebears, linking hereditary respect to ethical continuity.
